summary: Reliability tools from the external practices assessment: Meziantou.Analyzer on Core, AI and Server (rules that already fire held at suggestion, any other rule enforced; tools/analyzer-report.sh counts), a Core coverage trend script (tools/coverage.sh), a server-path desync soak (160 random commands through real sockets, views and action lists compared with an engine rebuilt from the saved commands), local-only crash reports with a Godot-free composer that scrubs tokens and home paths, and a Movie Maker spike result.
validation: check.sh (with the native client build and import) passes; 10 server integration checks including the new desync soak (a seat mix-up in the comparison fails it at command 0); 22 client transport checks including the crash bundle; the scratch-repo registration tests pass with the analyzer config; --write-crash-report writes a report on the Mac; coverlet and ReportGenerator verified on a Core slice.
remaining: Analyzer backlog (7,262 findings in 39 rules) is documented, not fixed; coverage is on demand, not in CI; Stryker mutation testing and a Sentry pilot deferred (custom runner needs an MTP wrapper; privacy review).
